arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
# Test grouping characters in decimals
tests = [
    ('{:f}', '1,234.56'),
    ('{:f}', '1_234.56'),
    ('{:d}', '1,234,567'),
    ('{:d}', '1_234_567'),
]
for fmt, val in tests:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        result = p.parse(val)
        print(f'{fmt!r} with {val!r} -> {result[0] if result else None}')
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
"
